Paris Commune, May 23rd, 1871, beginning of the Bloody Week.

Versailles' forces are storming through communard barricades all over the city, and here you are desperately resisting, armed with your old Chassepot rifle alongside your neighborhood comrades. In this historical imprint from a little-known period, relive the tragedy of the last moments of the Paris Commune. Watch out for reprisal when all the poor join in!
